svg.aria-label: Left: measured test accuracy from the same 50 initial labels through five rounds of 20 additional labels; both policies query the training pool. Right: four prediction methods using exactly the same 50 labels. Each curve is one fixed-seed run; no repeated-run error bars are plotted.
